paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academic researchers in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary has been recognized at the highest levels of academic excellence in China, as the program specifically targets scholars who have made significant contributions to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The 'Hundred People Project' represents a highly competitive selection process, with only a limited number of scholars chosen each year from across China's vast academic community [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This award places the Beneficiary among an elite group of scholars who have been recognized for their outstanding contributions to research and academic excellence in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.4]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education, which established an Award Committee composed of the director and deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, convenors of each department, and heads of departments, bureaus and units concerned of the Ministry of Education [Exhibit B10, p.5]. The selection process is rigorous, occurring every three years and involving evaluation by experts and scholars with high academic attainments selected from across the country, with all recommended materials being publicly displayed on the 'Network of Humanities and Social Sciences in Chinese Universities.' [Exhibit B10, p.4; Exhibit B10, p.5]. The award recognizes only the most outstanding contributions in humanities and social sciences research, with all awards divided into grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, making the Beneficiary's third prize a significant achievement among a highly competitive field of national submissions [Exhibit B10, p.5]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Awards Data Legacy of the Year Award in 2019, which is one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet in China [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.2]. The Data Awards are jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association and China Big Data Industry Observation, representing a collaboration of leading organizations in China's data industry [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process involved a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University and Peking University, who evaluated candidates during a two-month review period [Exhibit B3, p.3]. From this rigorous evaluation, only 28 Data individuals stood out to receive awards across seven categories, demonstrating the highly selective nature of this recognition [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who have been working deeply in the field of big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading their insights and experiences and educating the whole industry, placing the Beneficiary among an elite group of industry leaders [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was presented by the Communication Association of China and the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, representing recognition from one of China's premier professional associations in the field of communication [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The China Communication Conference is a major national conference that brings together leading scholars and practitioners in the field of communication research in China [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The Excellent Paper Award represents selective recognition of only the highest quality research presented at this prestigious national conference, demonstrating that the Beneficiary's work was judged to be among the best in the field [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary has received additional recognition through various industry and enterprise awards, including being named to the 2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100 list by the Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii) [Exhibit B4, p.4]. This recognition from the Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii) demonstrates that the Beneficiary's work has been evaluated and ranked among the top 100 most innovative enterprises in China's big data industry [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The Beneficiary also received the Annual Best Retailing Intelligent Data Application Award at the 14th Shanghai Retail Industry Summit & Retail Innovation Summit 2019, showing recognition across multiple industry sectors [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These additional awards further demonstrate the breadth and depth of the Beneficiary's recognition across China's data and technology industries, with recognition coming from diverse organizations including 36 Kr (Enterprise Service High-growth Company), the Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade (2018 Excellent Team Award of Internet Security Management), and various industry summits and conferences [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
